messages:
ben: heads up — after the driver+cuda1012 canary push to eu-west H100 pool we're seeing NCCL allreduce failures across a subset of nodes :warning:
ben: sample error: `NCCL WARN Call to ncclAllReduce returned error 8 (unhandled cuda error) at /build/nccl/common.cc:421`
ben: failing jobs are mostly long seq batch workloads hitting large KV cache reuse (SM90 kernels)
maria: is this limited to the canary tag or rolled to prod?
ben: canary only, ~30 nodes, traffic routed from 2 services for stress testing
ajay: thanks — two quick guesses: PTX/SM mismatch or driver minimum requirement for our custom sm90 kernels. did we change nvcc flags in the build?
maria: build flags unchanged. but driver bump went from 535.x -> 545.x on canary. nvcc/gcc versions same.
kelly: infra impact: autoscaler can't spin replacement H100s in eu-west until node images updated. if we rollback canary we lose capacity headroom — could push traffic to us-east as short-term mitigation
ben: created a quick grep of node logs, `dmesg` shows repeated ptx module linker timeouts on some hosts: `ptxlinker: unresolved symbol __nv_something`
ajay: can you paste `nvidia-smi -q` + driver output from one bad host? might be ABI mismatch with our kernel module.
ben: pasted in #eng-logs (link) — driver: 545.64, kernel-rt: 6.1.35, modules show compiled-for 545.64, but nvlink errors intermittently before the NCCL failures
maria: temporary plan: 1) pause canary expansion, 2) schedule rollback of driver on affected canary nodes, 3) add an automatic fallback rule to route eu-west gen-h100 traffic to eu-central until fix
kelly: noted — creating infra change: CHG-2026-218 to rollback driver on 30 nodes. also opening a ticket with fleet build to verify kernel module build flags and PTX compilation settings
ajay: also suggest enabling NCCL_LOG=INFO on a small failing job and collect `nccl-tests` allreduce reproducer. if it's PTX, we should be able to repro quickly
deploy-bot: deploy canary/driver-bump to eu-west rolled at 1769001200 by infra-release (sha: a1b2c3) :white_check_mark:
ben: customer risk: low right now (canary), but if we had expanded it we'd hit multi-az outages. cost note: rolling back will cost ~3h of extra ops + transient capacity hit ~$12k/day if we route to other regions
maria: assigning owners: ben (investigation), ajay (repro & hypothesis), kelly (rollback/change), infra-release (coord). I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:
ajay: I'll try repro with the exact SM90 kernel artifacts and nvcc flags and report back in 30m
ben: thanks. if we see quick repro we can decide between rebuilding kernel modules vs full driver rollback. both have different ops windows.
kelly: prepping rollback window 20:00 UTC if needed. marking on-call for SRE to monitor job queues and autoscaler thresholds
ben: noted, will update thread with `nccl-tests` output or rollback decision
maria: thanks all — keep it tight, and ping if any customer-facing impact emerges
